name: Albania Open 2026
information:
Welcome to the fourth official WCA competition in Albania!

Be sure to check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlbaniaOpen2026#80477-for-new-competitors).

**Registration is only possible online through this website. Check the [Register section](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlbaniaOpen2026/register) for details.**
